data.name: Rank the zombie double pack
data.detailed_description:
BRAND NEW update for The Rank the zombie double pack includes 2 of the rank the zombie games, PLUS a bonus game Pharaoh's run for 2026.  Featuring a zombie who found a spell book and  ever since can't help himself but to get in trouble. Run, shoot, fly or float through a great variety of levels as rank conquers his life after death.

Help Rank defeat all the evil he let out of the book. Across both games you will find that difficulty gradually increases as you progress. This challenge is met with evolving abilities, allowing Rank to use more powerful methods of dealing with the chaos—from standard platforming gunplay to taking control of flying spaceships to navigate certain levels and challenge formidable foes.

Varied Gameplay: Engage in diverse challenges, including intense platforming segments, frantic shoot 'em up sequences, thrilling flying spaceship levels, and massive, unique boss battles.

Unique Soundtrack: Each level features its own unique, original soundtrack, letting you defeat the evil in undeniable style.

Simple Controls: All movement and action controls are easily managed using directional keyboard buttons and the Shift key.

Accessible Fun: The visual nature makes the game simple to enjoy for everyone, requiring minimal reading (English text only).

Jump into Rank's boots and conquer the life-after-death challenge! Experience the high-energy chaos and classic cartoon horror fun today
